guidebook.intro: Somo la mwisho linarudi kando ya moto: hadithi za wajanja ambazo kila mtoto anazijua, na mafunzo yaliyofichwa ndani yake.

tips.title: He said, “…”
body: Kusimulia maneno ya mtu: **The king said to Abunuwasi, “Bring me milk!”** Alama za kunukuu (**“ ”**) huzunguka maneno yenyewe.
Bila nukuu, wakati hurudi nyuma: **He said that he was tired.** (Alisema kwamba amechoka.)

tips.title: The moral of the story
body: **Funzo** la hadithi ni **the moral** au **the lesson**: **The moral of the story is: greed is bad.**
**It teaches us that…** (inatufundisha kwamba…): **It teaches us that wisdom beats strength.**

culture.title: Wajanja duniani
body: Kila utamaduni una mjanja wake: **Sungura** Afrika Mashariki, **Anansi** buibui wa Ghana, na **Br’er Rabbit** wa Marekani, aliyetokana na hadithi za Kiafrika.
